name: R010-gengar-skill-swap-arena-trap
why: Challenge 5. The opponent leads Gengar (set 613, Skill Swap; Levitate). The player leads Dugtrio (set 564: Sand Veil or Arena Trap by the ability slot). Arena Trap has no switch-in message, so it is not in the AI's battle history. When Dugtrio's ability is Arena Trap, the AI's scoring of Skill Swap (AI_CV_ChangeSelfAbility, get_ability AI_TARGET) reads the trapping ability directly (battle_ai_script_commands.c:1369-1376), the runCvChangeSelfAbility trapper block, in the first AI turn. Dugtrio uses Double-Edge (no effect on the Ghost) so it never hurts Gengar; Gengar's Giga Drain likely knocks it out on turn 1 or 2, but the first scoring is enough. With Sand Veil the same turn may instead give the R009 roll.
